verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's own docs show bulk import and export of vault data, which moves many items at once without manual entry. The CLI and `bw serve` REST API also expose the whole vault for scripted management. No evidence documents native bulk edit, move, or delete of selected items, so per-item scripting with the CLI is a building block rather than a bulk-operations feature. Missing for 10: documented bulk edit/move/delete across selected items, bulk operations via MCP/API, hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Import logins and data from different password managers, other Bitwarden vaults, or encrypted exports to instantly transfer your information and skip manual entry.
Export your vault data, including logins and notes, to back up important information or transfer to a new Bitwarden vault.
The Bitwarden command-line interface (CLI) is a powerful, fully-featured tool for accessing and managing your vault.
